name: Product Table, Grid, List Builder For WooCommerce
author: theme funda

sections.description:
Product Table, Grid, List Builder For WooCommerce lets you build unlimited, reusable product displays for your WooCommerce store — no coding required. Design a layout once in the visual builder, then drop it anywhere on your site with a short, simple shortcode or the built-in Gutenberg block.

Key Features

  • Drag-and-Drop Column Builder — Visually add, remove, and reorder table/grid/list columns: Image, Name, SKU, Price, Categories, Tags, Attributes, Variations, Rating, Stock, and Add to Cart.
  • Custom Field Columns — Pull in any product custom field (post meta) as its own column, with a custom label.
  • Three Display Layouts — List, Grid, and Table, all driven by the same column configuration so you can switch layouts without rebuilding anything.
  • Advanced Query Builder — Filter products by category, tag, and attribute (combinable), quick filters for Featured/On Sale/Best Sellers, price range, stock status, and specific product exclusions.
  • Front-end Search — Let shoppers search within a builder’s products directly from the widget.
  • Front-end Filters — Optional category, tag, attribute, price range, and in-stock filter controls for visitors, with a one-click “Clear filters” reset.
  • Sortable Columns — Let visitors click Name or Price column headers (table layout) to sort products live.
  • Add to Cart From the Table — Ajax add-to-cart straight from the list, grid, or table — no page reload, with instant “Added ✓” feedback.
  • Floating Cart — Optional floating cart bubble so shoppers always see they’ve added something.
  • Appearance Customization — Accent color, text color, border color, font size, border radius, border width, and hover effects (lift, zoom, or none) — all per builder.
  • Flexible Pagination — Load More button, numbered pages, or no pagination at all.
  • Duplicate & Reuse — Clone any builder in one click and tweak the copy instead of starting from scratch.
  • Unlimited Builders — Create as many Table, Grid, or List builders as you need, each with its own simple shortcode (e.g. [gmwplw_product_layout id="1"]) and optional Gutenberg block.
  • WooCommerce HPOS Compatible — Fully compatible with WooCommerce’s High-Performance Order Storage.

How It Works

  1. Go to Product Builders in your WordPress admin.
  2. Click New Builder, choose a layout (List, Grid, or Table), and configure your columns, filters, and appearance.
  3. Copy the generated shortcode (or use the Gutenberg block) and paste it into any post, page, or template.
sections.changelog:
3.4.0

  • Expanded the front-end filter bar with price range and in-stock filters, plus a “Clear filters” reset
  • Column builder: drag-and-drop reordering, enable/disable any column, and custom field columns
  • Advanced query builder: multi-select category, tag, and attribute filtering
  • Front-end search, sortable table columns, ajax add-to-cart, and an optional floating cart
  • New Appearance tab: accent/text/border colors, font size, border radius/width, hover effects
  • Simple, sequential shortcode IDs instead of long UUIDs
  • Declared WooCommerce HPOS compatibility
  • Refreshed admin UI (page header with Support link) and a full front-end visual redesign

3.0

  • Renamed to “Product Table, Grid, List Builder For WooCommerce” to reflect what it actually does
  • Removed the “Product Widget” custom post type entirely — layouts (“Builders”) are now stored as plugin settings, managed from a dedicated top-level admin page
  • New “Product Builders” admin page: create, edit, and delete unlimited Table/Grid/List builders, each with its own shortcode, from one screen — no more separate post-per-layout editor
  • The admin page is a real React app written in JSX (src-admin/admin-app.jsx), built with @wordpress/scripts (package.json + webpack.config.js included) — run npm install && npm run build after editing it
  • New REST endpoints for full builder CRUD (list, get, create, update, delete)
  • Added a Settings link on the Plugins page pointing to the new Product Builders screen

2.1

  • Removed the legacy PHP-rendered fallback entirely — the front end is now 100% React (wp.element), with no server-rendered markup path left
  • Added “Load More” pagination to the front-end list, grid, and table views
  • Moved from in-browser Babel compilation to a proper build step (@wordpress/scripts) for the admin app, so there’s a real package.json to install and rebuild from

2.0

  • Removed the classic WordPress sidebar Widget entirely — use the shortcode or the block instead
  • Added a Table display layout alongside List and Grid
  • Rebuilt both the admin settings screen and the front-end product display as React apps (using wp.element, no @wordpress/components) backed by a new REST API, replacing the old PHP form and server-rendered markup

1.1

  • Rebuilt the Gutenberg block editor picker with a custom, elegant design instead of the default @wordpress/components dropdown
